name: Examination
definition: 以患者为对象、在某一日期实施的一组抗磷脂抗体及相关凝血与自身抗体检测结果的记录。 Counterexample: 与 Laboratory 检验记录混淆：检查记录侧重抗磷脂抗体、ANA、狼疮抗凝物等专项免疫与凝血检查，检验记录侧重生化与血常规等常规实验室指标。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Examination; provenance: direct source Examination

name: Laboratory
definition: 以患者为对象、在某一日期实施的一组生化、血常规与凝血实验室检测结果的记录。 Counterexample: 与 Examination 检查记录混淆：实验室检验记录以生化、血细胞计数和凝血酶原时间等常规指标为主，检查记录以抗磷脂抗体和自身抗体等专项指标为主。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Laboratory; provenance: direct source Laboratory

name: Patient
definition: 接受医疗检查与实验室检验服务的自然人，具有性别、出生日期、入院与诊断等属性。 Counterexample: 与检查记录、检验记录等信息记录混淆：患者是接受医疗服务的自然人，检查与检验记录是描述其检查结果的文档性条目。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Patient; provenance: direct source Patient

name: SLE_Diagnosis
definition: Patient has a diagnosis of SLE recorded.

name: APS_Diagnosis
definition: Patient has a diagnosis of APS recorded.

name: RA_Diagnosis
definition: Patient has a diagnosis of RA recorded.

name: AntiCardiolipin_IgM
definition: Anti-cardiolipin IgM antibody measurement.

name: UricAcid
definition: Uric acid level in laboratory test.

name: Hematocrit
definition: Hematocrit level in laboratory test.

name: Thrombosis
definition: Thrombosis severity recorded in examination.

name: AntiSM
definition: Anti-Smith antibody measurement.

name: TotalCholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol level in laboratory test.

name: RedBloodCell
definition: Red blood cell count in laboratory test.

name: IgA
definition: Immunoglobulin A level in laboratory test.

name: LDH
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase level in laboratory test.

name: ProthrombinTime
definition: Prothrombin time in laboratory test.

name: Symptoms
definition: Symptoms recorded in examination.
scope: Examination where Symptoms IS NOT NULL

name: Admission
definition: Admission status of patient.
aliases: immediately followed at the outpatient clinic

name: Sex
definition: Patient sex.

name: Birthday
definition: Patient date of birth.

name: FirstDate
definition: Date of first hospital visit.

name: ExaminationDate
definition: Date of examination.

name: Description
definition: Description field in patient record.

name: AbnormalUricAcid
definition: Uric acid outside normal range based on sex. Formula: CASE WHEN Sex = 'M' AND UricAcid > 8.0 THEN 1 WHEN Sex = 'F' AND UricAcid > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: UricAcid = Laboratory.UA; Sex = Patient.SEX

name: NormalUricAcid
definition: Uric acid within normal range based on sex. Formula: CASE WHEN Sex = 'M' AND UricAcid <= 8.0 THEN 1 WHEN Sex = 'F' AND UricAcid <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: UricAcid = Laboratory.UA; Sex = Patient.SEX

name: AbnormalHematocrit
definition: Hematocrit outside normal range. Formula: CASE WHEN Hematocrit > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Hematocrit = Laboratory.HCT

name: NormalAntiSM
definition: Anti-SM result is normal (negative or weak positive). Formula: CASE WHEN AntiSM IN ('-', '+-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: AntiSM = Laboratory.SM

name: NoThrombosis
definition: Patient has no thrombosis. Formula: CASE WHEN Thrombosis = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Thrombosis = Examination.Thrombosis

name: CholesterolDecreaseRate
definition: Rate of decrease in total cholesterol between two months. Formula: (TotalCholesterol_Nov - TotalCholesterol_Dec) / TotalCholesterol_Nov. Inputs: TotalCholesterol = Laboratory.T-CHO

name: LowRedBloodCell
definition: Red blood cell count below normal. Formula: CASE WHEN RedBloodCell < 3.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: RedBloodCell = Laboratory.RBC

name: NormalIgA
definition: IgA level within normal range. Formula: CASE WHEN IgA > 80 AND IgA < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: IgA = Laboratory.IGA

name: AbnormalLDH
definition: LDH level above normal range. Formula: CASE WHEN LDH > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: LDH = Laboratory.LDH

name: AbnormalPT
definition: Prothrombin time above normal range. Formula: CASE WHEN ProthrombinTime >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: ProthrombinTime = Laboratory.PT

name: FemalePercentage
definition: Percentage of female patients in a group. Formula: SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100. Inputs: Sex = Patient.SEX

name: MaleToFemaleRatio
definition: Ratio of male to female patients. Formula: SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Inputs: Sex = Patient.SEX

name: Age
definition: Patient age calculated from birthday. Formula: YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - YEAR(Birthday). Inputs: Birthday = Patient.Birthday

name: Diagnosis
definition: Patient diagnosis codes.

name: ThrombosisSeverity
definition: Thrombosis severity codes.

name: AdmissionStatus
definition: Admission status codes.

name: Sex
definition: Patient sex codes.
